keyword: chipotle buy one get one free
claims: Chipotle is offering a Buy One Get One (BOGO) free entrée deal on Friday, March 13, 2026, from 3 p.m. to 4 p.m. local time.
The deal is valid in-store for customers with any tattoo (real, temporary, or drawn).
The offer requires purchasing a full-priced entrée (burrito, bowl, salad, or tacos) to get another free.
The offer has a limit of five free items per check.
Show a tattoo (including drawn-on) to the cashier, says Facebook users.
Participating U.S. and Canada locations, notes Newsweek.
Kids' meals do not count as a qualifying entrée, according to Chipotle.ca.
This promotion is part of the "tatted like a Chipotle bag" event, explains the Houston Chronicle.
